Historical v24 summary: the following text describes the unchanged inherited five-field linear-response checkpoint, published as record 22347452 (semantic version 2026.09.05-v24). It is retained for historical context. The main Description above describes the current source/operator update.

Historical v24 plain-language summary

This checkpoint completes an error-controlled calculation across the whole domain of a registered fixed-background five-field linear mathematical model. It joins 176 calculation regions with exactly matching boundaries, then includes bounds for the equation error, background uncertainty, boundary-data error and source integration. The resulting two-by-two response matrix has a determinant between 2.12278154373842557755059 and 2.53743323308364125340774. Because this interval is entirely positive, the two selected input pulses produce linearly independent output patterns in the two chosen mathematical readouts, within the model's stated assumptions.

The advance is a complete certification argument for this adjoint calculation over the full domain. Earlier project checkpoints already reported rank-two results by other arguments. This release does not claim a more precise determinant estimate or external mathematical novelty.

The conclusion depends on the archived background branch and inherited equations, source identities and stability bounds. A separate rigorous error enclosure for the independent forward calculation remains open. The detector normalizations are mathematical coefficient conventions; they do not establish physical measurement sensitivity or observational accessibility.

These results do not show that a higher-dimensional blast caused the Big Bang. Nonlinear persistence, agreement with cosmological observations and the proposed physical mechanism remain unestablished. The reviews and replays are internal checks, not external peer review or proof-assistant formalization.

metadata.description:
This additive HDBLAST mathematical-methods edition completes a certified calculation of the prescribed Bunch-Davies incoming-state prehistory target on the inherited fixed geometry. It also archives the October5 finite-band Ward/contact bookkeeping and October7 incoming-state transfer theorem. All23 files from published record23114217 are preserved; four additions give27 files totaling 448,387,915 bytes.

Both independently implemented bounded routes enclose U and W for two compact source profiles at nine exact rational momenta, including the analytic normalized k=0 limit. All36 rectangle pairs and72 component intervals intersect; maximum actual exported L1 radii are below1.555e-21 and3.138e-23, within the fixed1e-20 target gate. Fresh extraction replay in normal and optimized Python reproduces every DATA byte and scientific budget component. An independent saved-output review verifies the four runs and all proof/control receipts.

The exact prescribed source and zero-past condition determine the continuum target; no arbitrary state was substituted at the matching time. U and W are entire at k=0, while certified nonzero W(a,0) proves a simple infrared pole in A=W/(2ik) for both sources. The matching-time first-order Bogoliubov coefficients have opposite1/k poles and are not uniformly small at fixed represented epsilon as k approaches zero. Their field combination stays finite; the higher-order epsilon remainder and nonlinear state are not enclosed.

A separately scoped continuous source-and-real-coefficient representation certificate gives scaled density upper4.094e-21 and pressure upper1.625e-18 on0<k<=256 and eta in[-4.5,-3.5]. Only the representation DIFFERENCE propagates homogeneously under identical subsequent forcing; the source is still active. These bounds exclude continuous numerical phase/ODE arithmetic, saved binary80 state comparison, time/momentum quadrature, full contacts and ultraviolet tails.

Original stored-state error remains NOT_ENCLOSED. The full twelve-case2e-8 pressure/contact continuum certificate remains UNRESOLVED; metric calibration remains FAIL. Physical energy normalization, coupled gravity, heating, thermalization, a sustained radiation era, observational agreement and a higher-dimensional cause of the Big Bang remain NOT_ESTABLISHED. External novelty remains NOT_ASSESSED. Internal AI-assisted reviews are not external peer review or proof-assistant formalization.

Start with the immutable scientific report: https://github.com/maldonado-research/HDblast/blob/7fbde527a9031baccd1f04b7ce3e8b905b2fdf10/research/HDBLAST_CHECKPOINT_20261007_BD_PREHISTORY/RESULTS.md. The prospective freeze remains a253f50158051881f18bbdec81c12dbbb4f49eba. Main concept DOI10.5281/zenodo.17088132 and previous main editions are preserved. Companion23111008 remains in concept10.5281/zenodo.22922927. Reports/data retain CC BY4.0, code its included MIT license and third-party material its own license.
